polls.notes: 5 Borough Barometer. The only primary Honan document found for this poll is a July 1, 2026 memo ("Jewish New Yorkers and Mayor Mamdani") hosted by Jewish Insider, which reports results ONLY by Jewish (n=99) vs. non-Jewish (n=515) subgroups; no citywide total is published in it. Values not stated in the memo text (Don't Know figures, "Mainstream" and "Heading in the right direction" figures) were read from the memo's bar-chart images, not from text. Memo says survey "conducted independently by Honan Strategy Group." Release date = memo date. Many other questions from this same poll (taxing the rich, electric bills, NYC "greatest city," pride in America, Democratic Party favorability among 446 Democrats, state budget, data centers, congressional primaries) appear only in news coverage reposted on honanstrategy.com; logged in gaps.
